description: This file contains implementation of static graph fusion and optimization routines for Torch JIT runtime, including functions for creating fusion groups, merging nodes, and performing tensor expression fusion.

classes.name: Operation
classes.description: Represents a callable operation created for static subgraph execution.

methods.name: createStaticSubgraphRuntime
methods.description: Creates a runtime function for executing a static subgraph node.

methods.name: canHandle
methods.description: Checks if a node can be handled for fusion based on input types and kind.

methods.name: canMerge
methods.description: Determines if two nodes can be merged into a fusion group.

methods.name: getOrCreateStaticSubgraph
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a static subgraph node for fusion.

methods.name: sortReverseTopological
methods.description: Sorts input values in reverse topological order within a block.

methods.name: debugDumpFusionGroup
methods.description: Outputs debug information about a fusion group node.

methods.name: tryMerge
methods.description: Attempts to merge a node into a fusion group, moving nodes as needed.

methods.name: createFusionGroup
methods.description: Creates a fusion group by merging compatible nodes.

methods.name: scanNode
methods.description: Analyzes a node and attempts to create or merge into a fusion group.

methods.name: inlineIfTooSmall
methods.description: Unmerges small fusion groups below a size threshold.

methods.name: inlineSmallFusionGroups
methods.description: Recursively inlines small fusion groups within a block.

methods.name: createFusionGroups
methods.description: Main routine to create fusion groups in a block, merging adjacent groups.

methods.name: inlineFallbackGraphs
methods.description: Unmerges fallback graphs in the main graph.

methods.name: performTensorExprFusion
methods.description: Performs tensor expression fusion on a graph with sample inputs.
